identity: Plain denim trousers, an alternative to the skirt. A hip panel plus a fitted tube down each leg to the ankle. Each tube's top is the leg's own dome, so it swings with the leg exactly as the bare leg does; the hip panel is drawn last and reaches wide enough to stay over the tube tops through the whole stride.

regions.note: far leg tube. 0 fits leg_far.leg_far_top (dome), 1 fits leg_far.leg_far_out (down the outside), 3 fits leg_far.inseam reversed (ankle->centre); 2 the ankle hem, 4 crosses the centre so it overlaps the near leg.

hip panel / seat, drawn last. Its whole outline is the wearer's lower torso: 0 fits torso.low_waist across the top, 1 fits torso.lower_torso_right down the right side and underside to the crotch, 2 fits torso.lower_torso_left reversed back up the left. Sits flush with the body, never proud of it.
